newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CLB says 850 mln bfr stolen, insurance to cover.
newsitem.headline: CLB says 850 mln bfr stolen, insurance to cover.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Belgium (CLB), a unit of French Credit Lyonnais, on Thursday confirmed reports in Belgian media that an employee stole 850 million Belgian francs ($24.3 million) from the Belgian bank.
CLB Chief Executive Officer Philippe Cloes said that the bank hoped to recover part of the money and that whatever amount was not recovered would be covered by the insurance.
There would be no impact on 1996 earnings, he said. In 1995 CLB earned a 628 million franc profit. ($ = 34.93 Belgian Francs)
